description: merge.watches: the standing merge watches — the merges the gate is still checking. A watch covers one merge event (the join carries the root, the loop, the PR, the rule revision and the run) with its state (the closed five), how many times it has checked, when it checks next, and its last words (detail). Filtered by state when named; the answer is the queue's standing, not its history.

watches.detail: the post-merge check is red at the merge SHA — the gate re-runs on the next check
